title: NBA Live 98
overview:
The Soul of Hoops Returns with Power!

NBA Live 98. Experience the NBA lifestyle. Hip graphics and progressive music combine with the most realistic competitive gameplay available. Live 98 feeds you the raw power of today's NBA. Power control, Power moves, and Power gameplay.

Take Control
- New: DirectDunking - One Hand, Straight Up, Reverse, Finger Rolls, and More - on command
- New: DirectPassing - Pass to Any Player, Any Time.
- Tight Player Moves - Spin, Crossover, Between the Legs, and More - on command
- New: 3-Point Shootout

NBA Live Gameplay
- Players play exactly like their real NBA counterparts
- Real NBA Stats, Real NBA Players, Real NBA Moves.
